author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
Microsoft has spent hundreds of billions on Copilot — and less than 3% of users are actually using it. A former Microsoft VP called them out on Twitter and it got spicy fast. We break down the numbers, the departures, and what this means for Microsoft's future.
